body.name: \(L_n\) and \(U_n\)
body.construction:
For nonempty \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\), set
\[
 L_n(a)=\max\{-B_Y,\inf_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)-b_{\mu,n}\},
 \qquad
 U_n(a)=\min\{B_Y,\sup_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)+b_{\mu,n}\}.
\]
If \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}=\varnothing\), set \(L_n(a)=U_n(a)=0\) for every \(a\in I\). The feasible correspondence has a closed graph and compact values in the fixed coefficient/weight/atom box, while \((a,\theta)\mapsto\mu_{\theta}(a)\) is jointly continuous; the measurable maximum theorem therefore makes the infimum and supremum value functions jointly sample-and-index measurable. Endpoint ordering is a property to be proved from the outer-sieve constraints rather than imposed by this definition.
